2607.11771.title: Evaluating RE Practices for Explainability: Synthesizing Insights from Daimler Truck into an Explainable RE Framework Proposal
2607.11771.paper_summary: Explainability has emerged as a critical requirement for AI-based systems, particularly in safety-critical and regulated domains. Although prior research has proposed frameworks, patterns, and user-centered approaches to support explainability, there is limited empirical understanding of how existing Requirements Engineering (RE) practices support explainability requirements across the RE lifecycle, especially in an industrial context. This paper reports early findings from an ongoing industry-based study investigating how explainability requirements are elicited, specified, and validated using established RE techniques. We conducted a multi-phase qualitative study with eight practitioners at Daimler Truck, employing think-aloud protocols and moderated group discussions across requirements elicitation, specification, and validation steps. Our preliminary analysis reveals recurring challenges across all steps, including conceptual ambiguity during elicitation, limited testability and expressiveness during specification, and fragmented validation due to vague criteria and regulatory uncertainty. These findings indicate that current RE practices provide limited support to systematically address explainability requirements. The paper contributes empirical insights into step-specific and cross-cutting challenges and outlines a research vision toward developing an empirically grounded RE framework for explainable AI-based systems.
2607.11771.paper_summary_zh: 解釋性已成為基於 AI 系統的一項關鍵需求，特別是在安全關鍵和受監管的領域。儘管先前的研究已提出框架、模式和以用戶為中心的方法來支持解釋性，但對於現有需求工程 (RE) 實踐如何在 RE 生命週期中支持解釋性需求的實證理解仍然有限，尤其是在工業背景下。本文報告了正在進行的基於行業的研究的初步發現，該研究調查了如何使用既定的 RE 技術來引出、規範和驗證解釋性需求。我們與戴姆勒卡車的八位從業者進行了多階段的質性研究，採用了思考大聲說出協議和主持的小組討論，涵蓋需求引出、規範和驗證步驟。我們的初步分析顯示所有步驟中都存在重複的挑戰，包括在引出過程中的概念模糊性、在規範過程中的有限可測性和表達性，以及由於模糊標準和監管不確定性導致的驗證碎片化。這些發現表明，當前的 RE 實踐對於系統性地解決解釋性需求提供的支持有限。本文為步驟特定和跨領域挑戰提供了實證見解，並概述了朝著發展基於實證的解釋性 AI 系統 RE 框架的研究願景。
